name: Squirrels on the Chestnut Tree
dimensions: Painting: 97 x 39.4 cm (38 3/16 x 15 1/2 in.); Overall with knobs: 181.6 x 58 cm (71 1/2 x 22 13/16 in.)
summary: One squirrel perches on a branch nibbling a chestnut, while the other on ground is approaching a fallen chestnut.
